data.name: Asish
data.gender_notes: Asish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asish is derived from the Sanskrit word असिष (asishaḥ), meaning ‘wise’, ‘discerning’, or ‘intelligent’. This name is associated with the god Vishnu and is considered auspicious in Hindu culture. The name Asish carries the meaning “Wise, Discerning, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asish usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, discerning, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Asish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Discerning, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asish total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
